newsitem.title: USA: Proler Intl says Hugo Neu seeks arbitration.
newsitem.headline: Proler Intl says Hugo Neu seeks arbitration.

text.p: Proler International Corp said on Monday it received notice from Hugo Neu Corp calling for arbitration of disputes over the companies' joint ventures.
The arbitration notice apparently sought to block Schnitzer Steel Industries Inc's proposed $7.50 per share tender for Proler, the company said in a statement.

Hugo Neu Corp called for arbitration of certain disputes relating to three joint ventures in which it and Proler were owners. Hugo Neu apparently complained Schnitzer was a competitor of the joint ventures and was therefore trying to prohibit a merger between Proler and Schnitzer, Proler said.
Hugo Neu, which was Proler's scrap metals partner, declined to comment.
Proler, which said Hugo Neu's claims were without merit, said Hugo Neu was seeking unspecified damages allegedly in excess of $50 million.

"The purported arbitration action by Hugo Neu Corp appears to be nothing more than another attempt to undermine our merger agreement with Schnitzer," Proler's President Bruce Wilkinson said in a statement.
Proler sued Hugo Neu in Texas last week for allegedly interfering with the merger agreement.
